versions.content: Name Icom Switch_ Error Type Kind Enumeration Range ICOM_ SWITCH_ E_ OK 0x00 The activation of Pretended Networking was successful. ICOM_ SWITCH_ E_ FAILED 0x01 The activation of Pretended Networking was not successful. Description Icom Switch_ Error Type defines the errors which can occur when activating or deactivating Pretended Networking. Available via Com Stack_ Types.h
